Q937.reason: Morphine is an opioid CNS depressant that reduces pain and causes sedation, not alertness, insomnia, or diarrhoea.

Q922.reason: High-intensity fatigue is ATP demand outrunning resynthesis; ADP rises as ATP is hydrolyzed, so production is not stopped by a fall in ADP.

Q992.reason: Rape is a general-intent crime, so only a reasonable mistake about consent is a defense, and voluntary intoxication does not excuse an unreasonable belief.
